# ✨ Hand Alike  
Hand Alike is a client-side Fabric mod that makes dropped items look exactly like they do when held in your hand.

## 🌟 Features
- 🖐️ Makes dropped items use the same model as when held in first or third person.
- 🎨 Preserves custom item models and resource pack overrides.
- ⚡ Lightweight with minimal performance impact.
- 💻 Client-side only — no server installation required.

---
